observations.methods: NOAA PSL NCEP/NCAR R1 Gaussian grid and GPCP v2.3 regular grid. GPCP land mask is nearest NCEP cell. Precipitation rates are converted to 365.25/12-day months.

drifterCurrentClimatology.method: One degree stride. Cells with all 12 months of U and V. Latitude coverage is 72.875 S to 84.125 N.

projectionOnly.scope: Reference mesh monthly solve. Each case replaces one forcing while all other forcing and terrain remain fixed.

calibrated.scope: Reference mesh monthly solve. Each case replaces one forcing while all other forcing and terrain remain fixed.
